purpose: Run 5 plan derived from Run 4. Keep fast research lanes cycling through genuinely different variants, but treat ~2m+ lanes as bounded attempts so they do not burn the whole research budget on repeated timeout/controller failures. Harvest all lanes and feed results back into the learning record. Production specialists remain off-limits.

lanes.aider-direct: Preflight Aider/runtime invocation first; if invocation is sub-2m but zero-diff, run genuinely different adapter/context variants across cycles. Classify repeated zero-diff fast exits separately from model non-materialisation.
lanes.aider-diff: Compare map sizes 256/512/768 only after confirming Aider actually starts; record invocation latency and materialisation separately.
lanes.aider-udiff: Symbol-first udiff with refreshed context; distinguish adapter start, model response and workspace materialisation.
lanes.aider-whole: Whole-file editing only after runtime preflight; enforce export preservation and minimal-diff gates.
lanes.aider-scoped: Exact-function targeting with refreshed source context; stop treating repeated sub-2m zero-diff exits as model-quality evidence.
lanes.aider-architect: Separate planning overhead from editor execution and record whether the editor stage actually starts.
lanes.failure-replay: One bounded replay/recovery attempt; success requires materialisation and behaviour, not recovery exit alone.
lanes.performance-lab: Measure validation, model invocation and recovery overhead separately; use the deterministic control as the reference.
lanes.shadow-architecture: One bounded retry experiment with stage telemetry; do not repeat ~3m controller failures across the remaining budget.
lanes.adversarial: One bounded adversarial attempt with exact-file and post-edit acceptance checks.
lanes.fast-deep: Test one fast/deep budget pair per cycle; escalate only on failed acceptance and record fast-path latency separately.
lanes.challenger: Generate falsifiable hypotheses from Run 4 failures, especially export-preservation, stale fallback anchors, and sub-100ms Aider exits; pair each with an execution test.
lanes.dependency-plan: Generate target/dependency maps for the Run 4 failure classes, then pair them with a concrete execution test.
lanes.direct-ollama-json: Separate runtime/schema preflight from workspace editing; record adapter availability before judging JSON quality.
lanes.openhands-sdk: Probe import, model construction and workspace stages separately; do not conflate SDK availability with editing quality.
lanes.deterministic-control: Repeat the stable control and retain it as the regression baseline.
lanes.evolution-selected: Test the latest Evolution hypothesis against Run 4 evidence: measure controller non-materialisation, model non-materialisation, fallback recovery, and verified success separately.

run4Evidence.fastResearchLoop: Sub-2m lanes ran all 5 cycles with distinct variants; 2m+ lanes also repeated in Run 4 because the old continue threshold was 5m.
run4Evidence.boundedLaneFix: Run 5 loop threshold changed to 120s so ~190s timeout/controller lanes stop after one bounded attempt.
run4Evidence.strongestResearch: deterministic-control produced 5/5 materialised passing controls; fast-deep produced a passing materialised edit in one bounded run; evolution-selected produced one passing materialised cycle among five.
run4Evidence.productionHarvest: Scene candidate passed independent QA and adds duration-bounded shot-count control. Director, Caption and Continuity candidates require manual scrutiny before promotion; Caption was rejected because its candidate contained unreachable duplicated caption application logic.
run4Evidence.productionFailureClasses: Timeline/Music/Media/Render repeatedly hit structured-fallback 150s timeouts and stale deterministic anchors; Intent fallback violated scope; Rhythm failed during Ollama startup with HTTP 500.
